decisions.reason: The three-pin connector preserves the existing NTC-on-J_BAT thermal sensing requirement; no safety or protection attribute changes.
The battery connector family, pitch, and pinout do not change the ESP32 sleep policy or wake sources.
The connector change does not alter charge-status indication through the main-board SK6812 LED chain.
The battery connector specification does not change the switched 5V rail, its GPIO control, or its sensor-power purpose.
The selected battery connector does not itself revise the existing placement, orientation, accessibility, spacing, or mounting-clearance constraints.
Selecting JST-PH for the battery does not change the existing general sourceability and compatible-alternative policy.
